Package com.blackbuild.annodocimal.ast

Class Documentation.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.blackbuild.annodocimal.ast.Documentation.Builder
Enclosing class:
Documentation
public static final class Documentation.Builder extends Object
A mutable, non-thread-safe builder whose build() results are independent immutable snapshots.
